messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Monroe <ellis.monroe@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: LumenHealth evaluation timeline — proposed rebaseline and risk log

Ellis —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the most recent mutual action plan (MAP_LumenHealth_v1.3.pdf) and the evaluation cases workbook we discussed. High-level summary:

- Current go-live target: 2028-09-30 (customer target).
- Our recommended rebaseline: 2028-10-20 to allow for procurement, SOC2 review, and a short canary.
- Key blockers: procurement sign-off, SOC2 attestation upload to your secure portal, and a 2-week window for internal LumenHealth integration tests (see Lumen-eval-cases.xlsx).

I've also attached a short risk log (risk_log_20280820.csv) that captures ETA impact and mitigations. Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Procurement release: Ellis to confirm approval path and expected sign date (we need a hard date by EOD Wed).
2) SOC2 evidence: Samir to confirm whether you can accept our SOC2 Type II report or need a bridge attestation.
3) Canary plan: Redwood to run a 2-day canary once procurement and SOC2 gates clear — propose 10/17–10/18 as a tentative slot.

If procurement slips past 9/22 we should proactively rebaseline to avoid a surprise close date slip. If helpful I can draft a short one-pager to share with procurement and your security team.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_LumenHealth_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]
[Attachment: Lumen-eval-cases.xlsx (XLSX, 160KB)]

From: Ellis Monroe <ellis.monroe@lumenhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: LumenHealth evaluation timeline — proposed rebaseline and risk log

Vivek —

Appreciate the artifacts and clear plan. Quick updates from our side:

- Procurement: our procurement owner is out on leave this week; the alternate approver has limited authority and will need legal sign-off on any terms that alter payment milestones. Expect a formal response by next Tuesday (8/28) at the earliest.
- Security: Samir says the SOC2 Type II looks fine but they need the full evidence package in our secure portal and a short questionnaire completed (we sent the portal link below). That process usually takes 5–7 business days after the artifacts are uploaded.
- Integration tests: our infra team requested one additional test scenario (SAML metadata rotation) which will add ~3 business days to their window.

Given the procurement and security gating items, we are likely looking at a slip. We can't commit to 9/30 any more. Please update the MAP with a rebaseline and a risk note for procurement dependency.

Portal link: https://portal.lumenhealth.com/sec/upload-request/8421

Ellis
Director, Product Partnerships
LumenHealth

Subject: Re: MAP: LumenHealth evaluation timeline — proposed rebaseline and risk log

Ellis —

Thanks for the fast turn. Viv and team — looping in a proposed operational rebaseline and a concise risk register update.

Actionable changes we've made in the attached risk_log_20280820.csv:
- Row 3 (Procurement approval lag): escalated impact to "High" (75% probability), estimated delay 12–18 business days. Mitigation: we will offer a short payment milestone amendment (10% credit on first month bill) if procurement requires an extended PO timeline; requires approval from revenue ops.
- Row 5 (SOC2 evidence turnaround): updated SLA to 7–10 business days; mitigation: Redwood will prepare a prefilled questionnaire and staged evidence package to reduce Lumen's work by ~40%.
- Row 7 (Integration test additions): added the SAML rotation test; contingency: perform a parallel canary with reduced user set if integration window overruns.

Proposed timeline (rebaseline):
- Procurement sign-off target: 2028-09-05 (soft) / 2028-09-12 (hard).
- Evidence upload complete: 2028-09-15.
- Integration & canary: 2028-10-10 — 2028-10-18.
- New go-live target: 2028-10-20.

Ellis, two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm by 8/28 whether procurement will accept the milestone amendment? If not, we will start executive outreach to remove the PO bottleneck.
2) Samir — please confirm receipt of the prefilled questionnaire by EOD Wed; we'll upload the staged evidence package immediately after.

Thanks — I put the short credit ask and the revenue ops owner in the risk log for transparency. Viv, Aditya: please prepare a 1-page exec escalation note in case we need an intro to Lumen health procurement SVP.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: risk_log_20280820.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
